identity: canonical video ID; frame integer resolves to exact existing zero-padded feature directory name
representative: existing indexed frame inside semantic interval closest to interval midpoint; lower frame wins tie; omit record if no indexed frame inside interval
scope: one representative frame per coarse semantic interval, not proof that entire interval satisfies an event
dedup: first ranked occurrence of exact video#frame; continue until100 unique frames; skip nonpositive BM25 records
fusion: RRF k60 over saved current top100 and mapped semantic top100; equal weights; stable current-first then semantic-first-seen tie order; retain100 frames
